title: Nature & Forest Immersion
subtitle: Untouched green lungs and biodiversity havens
description: Walk under ancient canopies, explore biodiversity hotspots in Silent Valley and Periyar, and breathe mountain air.

title: Slow Waterways & Canals
subtitle: Life lived at the rhythm of the tide
description: Drift through water lilies, listen to oar splashes, and witness life on Kerala's 900 kilometers of waterways.

title: Rituals, Art & Temple Lore
subtitle: Living traditions unbroken for centuries
description: From the fiery possession trance of Theyyam to the precise footwork of Kathakali and rhythmic roar of Chenda Melam.

title: Culinary Heritage
subtitle: Spices that brought the world to our shores
description: Fragrant coconut gravies, hand-crushed peppercorns, feather-light appams, and slow-simmered banana-leaf feasts.

title: Ayurveda & Rejuvenation
subtitle: The world's ancient healing cradle
description: Replenish body and spirit during Karkidakam monsoon with authentic herbal medicated oils and panchakarma therapies.

title: Peaks, Surfing & Wild Rapids
subtitle: For the adventurous spirit
description: Trek misty ridges, surf clean breaks at Varkala, or paraglide across the emerald hills of Vagamon.
